articles.description: The Reds reached a 3-year, $30 million deal with Tyler Stephenson to bring the free agent back to the team that drafted him 11th overall in 2015.
articles.title: Cincinnati Reds, Tyler Stephenson reunited on 3-year free agent deal

articles.description: Free-agent left-handed pitcher Brent Suter, a former Moeller High School standout, reportedly is signing a one-year, $4 million deal with the Yankees.
articles.title: Brent Suter, former Reds LHP from Moeller, reaches deal with Yankees

articles.description: Former Reds outfielder Deion Sanders returns to Cincinnati as a football coach in a town where he found religion and wanted to stay.
articles.title: Deion Sanders returns to Cincinnati with baseball memories: 'I wanted to stay'

articles.description: President Donald Trump posted on social media he'd pardoned Reds Hall of Famer Pete Rose, but it has no bearing on Baseball Hall of Fame voting.
articles.title: What Trump pardon means for Pete Rose's Hall of Fame case
